svg.title: Prefill speedups
svg.desc: All eighteen configurations measured in BF16 and FP16, including two regressions per dtype. Geometric mean speedups are 1.468 and 1.472. The measured candidate predates final numerical fixes. All plotted values are read from the retained comparison data.

g.text: Baseline b5474d8 → candidate 34bf268, before final numerical fixes. Final merged source has not been retimed on a healthy host.

g.text: Two runs × nine alternating timing rounds; each point uses aggregate latency, not a confidence interval. Clocks were not pinned.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526479

g.text: Source: data/main-comparison.json. Causal attention; W512 is the left-window control. Shapes receive equal weight in the geometric mean.
